listings.Tytuł: 50 m² maisonette apartment, central, partly furnished, fitted kitchen, parking space
listings.Opis:
Generously sized, well-kept apartment over two floors in a quiet but central location in Kleve.
The apartment is located in a single-family house with only one other apartment—an ideal retreat for anyone who values privacy, comfort and a connection to nature.

Features
- Kitchen cabinets, sink, cooker, oven, dishwasher   - Wardrobe, couch (chaise longue), TV cabinet, dining-serving cabinet, chest of drawers   - Kitchen table with 5 chairs, bathroom cabinet, 2 mirrors   - TV with satellite connection   - Lamps in the living rooms - Private parking space for your car
- Bathroom with bathtub
- Washing machine in the shared laundry room
- 250 m² garden
- 40 m² terrace
- 
Quiet location with panoramic views over Kleve and as far as the Emmerich Rhine bridge
- Access to the Reichswald forest at the end of the street


The apartment is located in one of the most sought-after residential areas of Kleve: quiet, close to nature and yet still near the city centre. 
To the rear, the view opens up over the private garden and a villa on the hillside; to the front, you can enjoy an impressive view over the city of Kleve up to the Rhine.
The Reichswald, a nearby recreation area, is within walking distance—ideal for strolls, jogging or relaxing hours in a green setting.

The service charges are currently reduced through self-managed services (e.g. cleaning the entrance hall, putting out rubbish bins, mowing the lawn in summer). Alternatively, a service provider can be commissioned (with a corresponding surcharge for service charges).  


Smoking is not permitted in the house.  


Long-term letting to 1–2 people is preferred. 
Information required:
 * Brief introduction and the reason for your move
 * Number of people moving in
* Desired move-in date


Required documents:
Schufa report
Tenancy self-disclosure form
Proof of income for the last three months
Proof of no rental arrears from the former landlord
